name.value: BC Liquor Distribution Branch - Wholesale Customer Centre

description.value: The BC Liquor Distribution Branch Wholesale Customer Centre in Victoria is a government-operated B2B facility supplying alcohol to over 200 licensed hospitality and retail customers in the greater Victoria area. It functions as a trade-only order and pickup point for restaurants, bars, hotels, and licensed retailers — not a walk-in retail store. The facility is part of the broader LDB Wholesale Operations network with distribution centres in Burnaby and Kamloops.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the BC Liquor Distribution Branch's Victoria Wholesale Customer Centre at 2219 Government Street, matching OSM address and phone (250-356-2906). The /contact subpage explicitly states it 'services over 200 hospitality customers' — meaning Licensee Retail Stores, Rural Agency Stores, Independent Wine Stores, Duty Free Stores, and high-volume hospitality customers — making this a trade-only B2B facility, not a publicly accessible retail store. No cyclist amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM category 'Groceries' (shop=wholesale) is a mismatch — this is a B2B wholesale liquor distribution centre with no public retail access.

Not accessible to the general public: the website explicitly states it services licensed trade customers only (Licensee Retail Stores, Rural Agency Stores, Independent Wine Stores, Duty Free Stores, and high-volume hospitality customers).

The OSM record's address (2219 Government Street) refers to the Victoria branch, but the website's primary Wholesale Customer Centre contact info (phone 604-775-0681, address 3383 Gilmore Way Burnaby) is for the Burnaby head office — OSM correctly captures the Victoria location.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a trade-only wholesale facility restricted to licensed business customers (hospitality, retail licensees, duty-free stores); it is not publicly accessible to general visitors or touring cyclists. It does not function as a retail store of any kind.

provenance.category_correction_reason: OSM tags this as shop=wholesale and it is categorized as Groceries, but this is a trade-only wholesale liquor distribution centre serving licensed businesses, not a grocery or general retail outlet.
